name: wren
description: ChatGPT writes in your Wren notebook by hand: study notes, math solutions, graphs and diagrams as real ink that syncs to your iPad.

interface.longDescription: Wren is a handwriting notebook and AI whiteboard for iPad. Ask ChatGPT for class notes, a worked math problem, a graph or a diagram, and it shows up in your Wren notebook written by hand. Wren can write study pages, step-by-step solutions, function graphs, formulas, labelled diagrams, checklists, tables, bar charts, timelines, flowcharts and mind maps. It writes Hindi, Arabic, Hebrew, Russian, Thai and other scripts too, and can mix them with English and math on the same line. The writing is real pen strokes, not a picture, so on your iPad you can erase it, move it or write next to it with your Pencil. You can start a new note, add pages to one you already have, or ask for a multi-page notebook. Pages you wrote yourself are never touched. When you connect, sign in with the Wren account you use on your iPad so your notes show up there.
defaultPrompt: Write study notes on photosynthesis in Wren
Graph y = x^2 - 4 in my Wren notebook
Add a timeline of World War II to my History note
